A395 architectural-dxf-extraction (geometry), A398 ada-plan-view-accessibility (door clear width, turning space... but handrails?). A395 handles extraction from CAD layers; combined. Accept both. Positive.

5. e081-c3: BOM for third-party library versions, modules — Maven BOM → A338 maven-dependency-management. Chinese with "BOM"/"module" — code_switch, fluent. Positive.

"creating new PDFs, merging/splitting, handling forms" — plausible. Accept A259, A137. Positive. Language: mostly Chinese with "PDF" — code_switch?
